anchor.note: Every cell shares this anchor: the head centre sits at x=162 and the feet rest on the baseline y=470, so frames never shift while cycling.

note: The source sheet contains exactly 7 figures, not 8. They were cut out with alpha connected-component labelling, so a cell can only contain its own character — the old 198px grid sliced through the artwork and pulled slices of neighbouring poses into every frame.
